summary:
### TL;DR
- No GitHub Changelog entries were published in this period.
- The only docs change is a cosmetic heading fix (`etc/hosts` → `/etc/hosts`) on the [GitHub-hosted runners page](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/concepts/runners/github-hosted-runners) ([commit](https://github.com/github/docs/commit/f63f0ee89415a24961bea1e58f2c67c727333b08)). It doesn't change any behavior or guidance.
- Teams using GitHub Actions don't need to do anything.

### Action required
Nothing this time.

### Security improvements
No new or changed security capabilities were announced in this period.

### Docs changes worth reading
No substantive documentation changes this time. The single update only corrects a section heading to use the absolute path `/etc/hosts` on the [GitHub-hosted runners page](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/concepts/runners/github-hosted-runners) ([commit](https://github.com/github/docs/commit/f63f0ee89415a24961bea1e58f2c67c727333b08)). The section's content was not modified.

docs.title: Use absolute path for /etc/hosts for clarity (#46608)
